title: DevBench — Debugger
subtitle: AmigaOS 4.1 on QEMU sam460ex · profile qemu-os4 · :3000

items.label: Target & symbols
items.text: Pick a bridge client, Launch / Attach / Launch & Attach / Detach, and load the project's symbols (MCP: amiga_debug_attach / amiga_load_symbols).

items.label: Run control
items.text: Continue (F5), Break (F9), Step Into (F11), Step Over (F10) (MCP: amiga_continue / amiga_step / amiga_next).

items.label: Breakpoints
